preview_draft_constant: PREVIEW DRAFT 480p — storyboard direction check only (composition & art direction, not identity): Obey the project frame 16:9. Shallow depth of field with FG/MG/BG separation; ARRI Alexa filmic look (soft, grainy, low-key default). Cinematic photoreal, never CGI/illustration. Characters described by text only (no reference lock at this stage); pick a deliberate non-frontal angle per shot and vary angles between adjacent cuts.
world_look: Medieval war fantasy, desaturated ash-grey world; the only warm color is ember amber; old faded gold and dark rust-brown accents of a southern kingdom of white stone, vineyards and wheat fields. No magic fireballs, no glowing runes.

characters.ELARA: Elara, 23-year-old woman border-village healer, dark brown hair self-cut unevenly with a knife (one side noticeably shorter, jagged), ash-smudged face, plain undyed linen dress with worn leather apron, herb-stained fingertips, small medical knife
characters.RIVEN: Riven, 27-year-old northern army commander, cropped dark-blond hair, weathered stern face, blue-grey steel plate over dark navy wool, small white-wolf emblem, long sword
characters.TORVAL: Torval, 40-something broad northern lieutenant, short grey beard, fur-lined dark cloak over steel
characters.CHILD: a 7-year-old village girl covered in ash, wrapped in an oversized faded shawl
characters.ELDER: an old refugee man with a walking stick and a bundle on his back
characters.SOLDIER: a young wounded northern soldier in torn navy wool and dented blue-grey armor
characters.MOTHER: a healer woman in her thirties, in plain linen
characters.OBSERVER: a hooded figure in an ash-grey cloak, face hidden in shadow
